Family Feud.name: Family Feud
Family Feud.summary: An adaptation of the TV quiz show where two families compete for cash prizes. These versions were all published by GameTek and developed by various developers between 1991 and 1994.

NBA All-Star Challenge.name: NBA All-Star Challenge
NBA All-Star Challenge.summary: NBA All-Star Challenge is a Sports game, developed by Beam Software and published by LJN Ltd., which was released in 1991.
